author: tedcruz
text:
Abdul El-Sayed is now telling voters he’s a capitalist.

His own sister says he isn’t. When a supporter says the goal is “getting him in,” she responds: “Exactly.”

The message could hardly be clearer: tell voters what they want to hear. Get power. Then pursue radical-left policies.
